module origen_134722 (
    input [15:0] a,
    input [15:0] b,
    input sel,
    output [31:0] result
);

    wire [31:0] mult_result;
    wire [31:0] div_result;

    multiplier mult (
        .a(a),
        .b(b),
        .result(mult_result)
    );

    divider div (
        .a(mult_result),
        .b(b),
        .result(div_result)
    );

    mux_2to1 output_mux (
        .a(mult_result),
        .b(div_result),
        .sel(sel),
        .out(result)
    );

endmodule

module multiplier (
    input [15:0] a,
    input [15:0] b,
    output [31:0] result
);

    wire [15:0] partial_products [15:0];
    wire [31:0] sum [14:0];

    genvar i, j;
    generate
        for (i = 0; i < 16; i = i + 1) begin : gen_partial_products
            assign partial_products[i] = a & {16{b[i]}};
        end

        for (i = 0; i < 15; i = i + 1) begin : gen_adder_stages
            wire [31:0] stage_in1, stage_in2;

            if (i == 0) begin
                assign stage_in1 = {16'b0, partial_products[0]};
                assign stage_in2 = {15'b0, partial_products[1], 1'b0};
            end else begin
                assign stage_in1 = sum[i-1];
                assign stage_in2 = {{15-i{1'b0}}, partial_products[i+1], {i+1{1'b0}}};
            end

            ripple_carry_adder_32bit adder (
                .a(stage_in1),
                .b(stage_in2),
                .sum(sum[i]),
                .cout()
            );
        end
    endgenerate

    assign result = sum[14];

endmodule

module divider (
    input [31:0] a,
    input [15:0] b,
    output [31:0] result
);

    reg [31:0] quotient;
    reg [31:0] remainder;
    reg [15:0] divisor;
    integer i;

    always @(*) begin
        quotient = 32'b0;
        remainder = a;
        divisor = b;

        for (i = 31; i >= 0; i = i - 1) begin
            if (remainder[31:16] >= divisor) begin
                remainder = remainder - {divisor, 16'b0};
                quotient[i] = 1'b1;
            end
            remainder = remainder << 1;
        end
    end

    assign result = quotient;

endmodule

module ripple_carry_adder_32bit (
    input [31:0] a,
    input [31:0] b,
    output [31:0] sum,
    output cout
);

    wire [7:0] carry;

    ripple_carry_adder_4bit rca0 (.a(a[3:0]), .b(b[3:0]), .cin(1'b0), .sum(sum[3:0]), .cout(carry[0]));
    ripple_carry_adder_4bit rca1 (.a(a[7:4]), .b(b[7:4]), .cin(carry[0]), .sum(sum[7:4]), .cout(carry[1]));
    ripple_carry_adder_4bit rca2 (.a(a[11:8]), .b(b[11:8]), .cin(carry[1]), .sum(sum[11:8]), .cout(carry[2]));
    ripple_carry_adder_4bit rca3 (.a(a[15:12]), .b(b[15:12]), .cin(carry[2]), .sum(sum[15:12]), .cout(carry[3]));
    ripple_carry_adder_4bit rca4 (.a(a[19:16]), .b(b[19:16]), .cin(carry[3]), .sum(sum[19:16]), .cout(carry[4]));
    ripple_carry_adder_4bit rca5 (.a(a[23:20]), .b(b[23:20]), .cin(carry[4]), .sum(sum[23:20]), .cout(carry[5]));
    ripple_carry_adder_4bit rca6 (.a(a[27:24]), .b(b[27:24]), .cin(carry[5]), .sum(sum[27:24]), .cout(carry[6]));
    ripple_carry_adder_4bit rca7 (.a(a[31:28]), .b(b[31:28]), .cin(carry[6]), .sum(sum[31:28]), .cout(carry[7]));

    assign cout = carry[7];

endmodule

module ripple_carry_adder_4bit (
    input [3:0] a,
    input [3:0] b,
    input cin,
    output [3:0] sum,
    output cout
);

    wire [3:0] carry;

    full_adder fa0 (.a(a[0]), .b(b[0]), .cin(cin), .sum(sum[0]), .cout(carry[0]));
    full_adder fa1 (.a(a[1]), .b(b[1]), .cin(carry[0]), .sum(sum[1]), .cout(carry[1]));
    full_adder fa2 (.a(a[2]), .b(b[2]), .cin(carry[1]), .sum(sum[2]), .cout(carry[2]));
    full_adder fa3 (.a(a[3]), .b(b[3]), .cin(carry[2]), .sum(sum[3]), .cout(carry[3]));

    assign cout = carry[3];

endmodule

module full_adder (
    input a,
    input b,
    input cin,
    output sum,
    output cout
);

    assign sum = a ^ b ^ cin;
    assign cout = (a & b) | (cin & (a ^ b));

endmodule

module mux_2to1 (
    input [31:0] a,
    input [31:0] b,
    input sel,
    output [31:0] out
);

    assign out = sel ? b : a;

endmodule

entry_point:
Agent entry point — start here

Round-trip tasks have two separate agent entry points:

  1. Stage 1: stage1/TASK.md
  2. Stage 2: stage2_template/TASK.md

Follow the stage panels below for each stage’s input files and required output. The accepted Stage 1 text is supplied to a fresh Stage 2 context; Stage 2 does not receive clean RTL or the Stage 1 conversation.

A stored instruction is distinct from the runtime launch message, which can add framing and execution limits. The agent uses the harness’s file-reading tools to inspect available inputs. The file list also includes human-review reference and oracle assets that must not be given to the evaluated agent.
